cases.finding: A-Evolve converts task execution evidence into persistent harness updates and evaluates later harness benefit, directly exercising S4 at its benchmark-defined evolving-system boundary. The evolver is benchmark-supplied rather than a canonical harness's native S4 path.

SkillEvolBench uses acquisition trajectories and verifier feedback to induce/revise persistent skills, freezes the learned library, and tests future context shift, adversarial variants and composition. The Skill Author belongs to the benchmark-defined organization.

The self-evolving mode updates persistent inner adaptation state from accumulated experience while the supplied tool/skill/agent harness changes across stages. Deployment-only evaluation is explicitly excluded from the direct-S4 classification.

SkillEvolBench can execute Codex CLI as an operational task solver, but the Skill Author and persistent adaptation protocol are benchmark-hosted. A Codex-backed run is therefore not evidence for canonical Codex S4 ownership or native S4 capability.

SkillLearnBench refines reusable skills from self or teacher feedback, but its family-level protocol is more tightly coupled to retries and same-task-family improvement and does not isolate frozen prospective deployment as cleanly as the direct S4 families.

FutureSim directly exercises chronological external sensing and forecast revision but closes on belief/forecast state rather than persistent organizational capability adaptation. Its family-level linkage remains observation-specific; five published recommended/native-CLI runs are recorded separately as adapter-preserved proxy observations for canonical Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode.

KADATH has a native closed S4 loop: independently graded environment/benchmark evidence informs model-driven mutation/reproduction, valid changed organism genomes are activated, and later epochs execute the changed capability. Its benchmark definition is generated and operator-approved per run and the reviewed repository does not publish a standardized reusable matched cross-harness result corpus for this native S4 path.
cases.ordinary_s4_boundary: The non-evolving kernel, locked benchmark, grading/evidence machinery and selection controls remain outside the evolvable organism genome during a run, so ordinary S4 can change the operational genome while keeping the S4 regulator boundary fixed.

cases.finding: super-agent's nightly Tone Mirror converts observed user interaction into a durable behavioral/tone profile that later ordinary turns inject into their context, giving a native persistent adaptation closure. The reviewed repository search did not recover published before/after future-turn benefit, retention/generalization, regression or cost measurements for that native S4 path.

cases.benchmark: BossConsole Tool Evolver live capability adaptation
cases.finding: BossConsole's credited Tool Evolver path can turn a capability request into a changed plugin, build and hot-reload it into the running installation, probe/verify the live capability and iterate. The reviewed first-party repositories did not expose a standardized published adaptation-results corpus suitable for a matched canonical S4 baseline.

Exo has a native S4 path that can create reusable tools/skills and can edit mounted prompts/source before activating changes through the guardian path. Because this reach may also alter the machinery that performs adaptation, an ordinary S4 benchmark must explicitly freeze the S4 decision/feedback regulator and identify a separate target capability. A run that improves the S4 regulator itself belongs to the separate self-organizing-S evidence class.
cases.ordinary_s4_baseline_rule: freeze-s4-regulator; permit persistent change only to the declared adaptation target

cases.finding: Headcount's native S4 path turns market/competitor/multi-year scenario evidence and early-warning distinctions into strategic options that return into executive/finance allocation. The reviewed repository does not publish a matched benchmark of this strategy-specific S4 path, so it is a domain candidate rather than evidence for a general primary score.

Henterprise's native strategy path senses markets, competition, regulation/technology and future uncertainty, constructs scenarios/options and returns them to the organization-wide executive/financial decision context. No reviewed matched strategy benchmark of that native S4 path was recovered, so it remains a domain-specific candidate.

OmniScientist's native S4 path retrieves the external scientific landscape, generates and screens hypotheses for novelty/feasibility, persists the selected direction and makes the later experiment stage consume it. The reviewed public evaluation surfaces do not provide a matched benchmark specifically measuring this S4 selection-to-future-experiment closure across canonical harnesses.
